objects.name: Analytic 2222
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) field device IPs receiving inbound connections from internet-sourced IP addresses on ICS protocol ports. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: inbound connection to field device Internet Protocol (IP) address from source outside RFC1918/organizational IP space on Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port
